english.title: Wilfully obstruct a detainee custody officer - immigration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully obstructed a detainee custody officer, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who was

(A)_[acting in accordance with escort arrangements]_
(B)_[performing custodial functions]_
(C)_[performing functions of a custodial nature at a short-term holding facility]_
(D)_[performing functions under section 51 of the Immigration Act 2016]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5 of Schedule 11 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
wilfully obstructed detainee custody officer
acting in accordance with escort arrangements or
performing custodial functions or
performing functions of custodial nature at short-term holding facility

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
